# ZOZ INNOVATIONS FZCO

> Applied AI and spatial technology studio based in Dubai, UAE. We direct viral AI commercials, architect autonomous multi-agent automation systems, engineer production-grade web & iOS applications, and produce high-end spatial 3D architectural walkthroughs. Shipped in weeks, with zero agency overhead.

Architects enterprise-grade autonomous multi-agent infrastructure, distributed backend systems, and translates architectural floor plans into photorealistic Blender walkthroughs.

## Core Capabilities

### 1. Viral AI Commercials & Visual Storytelling
- Direct-to-viral commercial videos engineered for high retention across TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and broadcast.
- High-end synthetic video, brand intros, visual effects (VFX), and 3D billboard assets without traditional on-location shoot overhead.
- Rapid visual iteration and asset generation pipelines with delivery in days.

### 2. Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems & Distributed Automation
- Production deployment of collaborative, role-based AI agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI) that autonomously execute complex operational workflows and multi-step data pipelines.
- Enterprise-grade backend infrastructure, deterministic tool-calling agents, and tailored retrieval workflows built to remove organizational bottlenecks.

### 3. AI 3D, Spatial Media & Architectural Walkthroughs
- Conversion of 2D CAD schematics and architectural layouts into photorealistic, navigable 3D Blender walkthroughs and virtual show spaces.
- Precision 3D modeling and environment compositing utilizing Maya, AutoCAD, and After Effects for real estate developers and spatial media activations.

### 4. High-Performance Web Platforms & Native iOS Applications
- Resilient, ultra-fast web platforms and interactive computational engines built on modern frontend frameworks and containerized deployments.
- Full-cycle native iOS mobile engineering (Swift) taken from architecture to App Store release in rapid 2–4 week cycles.
